2609.28344.title: Mizar: A 159M-Parameter Audio-Language Model for Audio Understanding
2609.28344.paper_summary: Audio-language models (ALMs) integrate acoustic perception with the knowledge encoded in language models, enabling contextual understanding of auditory events. Making these capabilities practical on devices with limited memory and computation motivates our focus on small ALMs with fewer than 200M parameters. We introduce a recipe that brings together architecture, data, and three-stage training to build Mizar, a 159.3M-parameter ALM. Its architecture connects a compact CED-Small audio encoder to SmolLM2-135M through a frequency-merging mapper. With supervision drawn from ReasonAQA, AudioMCQ, and AVQA, the model undergoes three training stages: audio-language alignment (Stage 1), audio-dependent fine-tuning (Stage 2), and post-training (Stage 3) aimed at strengthening weak skills while retaining learned capabilities. Across five random seeds, Mizar achieves mean accuracies of 52.92% on MMAU, 42.42% on MMAR, and 36.02% on ADQA-clean, surpassing the previous best-performing ALM below 200M parameters on all three benchmarks. It also supports local inference on a single CPU: on questions from the MMAU benchmark, the mean latency from opening the audio file to generating a complete answer is 1.09 seconds. Code and checkpoints are available at https://github.com/KaiyangLi1992/Mizar_159M.
2609.28344.paper_summary_zh: 音頻語言模型（ALMs）將聲音感知與語言模型中編碼的知識整合在一起，使得對聽覺事件的上下文理解成為可能。使這些能力在記憶和計算有限的設備上實用化促使我們專注於參數少於200M的小型ALMs。我們介紹了一個將架構、數據和三階段訓練結合起來的方案，以構建Mizar，這是一個擁有159.3M參數的ALM。其架構通過頻率合併映射器將緊湊的CED-Small音頻編碼器連接到SmolLM2-135M。模型在ReasonAQA、AudioMCQ和AVQA的監督下經歷了三個訓練階段：音頻語言對齊（第一階段）、音頻依賴的微調（第二階段）以及旨在加強弱技能的後訓練（第三階段），同時保留已學會的能力。在五個隨機種子下，Mizar在MMAU上達到52.92%的平均準確率，在MMAR上達到42.42%，在ADQA-clean上達到36.02%，在所有三個基準上超越了之前在200M參數以下的最佳表現ALM。它還支持在單個CPU上進行本地推理：在MMAU基準的問題上，從打開音頻文件到生成完整答案的平均延遲為1.09秒。代碼和檢查點可在https://github.com/KaiyangLi1992/Mizar_159M獲得。
